Name: SOUND_COMMON_SYSTEM_PARAM_ST
Description: Sound key/value settings, read once at sound startup. Lives in systemparam.parambnd, not regulation.bin. 10: sound ID of the hit/damage sound, a Wwise dynamic-dialogue event (type d); default d990000000. 100: aux (reverb) bus for sounds of emitters marked outdoor while the player is indoors; default _001_Outdoor. 101: aux bus for emitters marked indoor while the player is outdoors; default _004_Room_Large. Other emitters, and these when player and emitter are both indoors or both outdoors, follow the current reverb type (ReverbAuxSendBusParam).

Fields.Name: Param Value
Fields.Description: The setting's value (see the param description). Row 10: a sound ID (type letter + 9 digits, must be a type d dynamic-dialogue sound, e.g. d990000000). Rows 100/101: an aux bus name as in ReverbAuxSendBusParam, e.g. _001_Outdoor; a name with no matching ReverbAuxSendBusParam row gives those sounds no reverb.
